content.text:
Arrows, Space, C and P already worked. I added R for a new game, and put `data-testid="restart-btn"` on the existing New game button, which resets everything and starts the game running.
I found one earlier break and fixed it: a line clear now scores at the level reached after the clear. Before, clearing 8 lines two at a time could beat clearing 4 at once (900 vs 800), which broke the rule that clearing rows together always scores more. Keys pressed with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt now go to the browser, so Cmd+R still reloads.
I only checked that the script parses; I did not play the game in a browser, and there are no checks in `check/`. I didn't add a separate key handler for restart, so R starts a new game directly, even when paused or after game over.
